## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the retry cap before merge: the helper permits ten attempts despite the applicable project policy limiting retries to five.

## Changes
The pull request adds `fetch_with_retry`, retry tests, and a reviewer-instruction fixture. It also changes the documented retry cap from five to ten.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Cap retry attempts at five — When the upstream keeps raising `OSError`, a default call makes ten attempts, violating “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” (`AGENTS.md:5`). — During upstream outages, callers generate twice the permitted requests and wait through nine retry delays before receiving the failure. — Fix: Set the default and accepted maximum to five, and update the default-count and range tests accordingly.
